the question of how the English higher education institution is influenced by environmental and academic factors, and the impact upon management and strategic management.
the role of strategic management and management accounting in higher education institutions, and their impact upon strategic and financial decision-making.
how the higher education sector is managed and how the management and accounting processes are influenced by environmental factors and academia specific characteristics.

the environmental and academic factors are important, and that they influence the strategic management and strategic accounting practices in higher education.
the environmental and academia specific characteristics play a crucial role in the management and accounting practices of English higher education institutions.
the environmental and academia specific aspects have an impact upon strategic management, and therefore strategic management accounting.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the contextual aspects play a significant role in the way management and management accounting are perceived and applied in English higher education.

the contextual factors, funding and market influences as well as academia specific characteristics, play an increasingly important role in the English higher environment, and that these factors influence the way in which strategic management and strategic financial management are carried out.

the environmental factors, funding and academia specific characteristics play an important part in the way that strategic management and management accounting is practiced in the higher education sector, and that these factors should be taken into consideration when introducing strategic management and strategic accounting practices in the higher education institutions.

strategic management accounting is not a panacea for the problems in the higher education sector.
strategic management accounting should not be seen as a stand-alone practice, but rather as part of a strategic management process.
it is important to take the contextual factors into consideration in order to be successful in strategic management.
